title: Untested Queue Retry Backoff Regression Risk
description: Modifies retry backoff multiplier in task queue without regression test validating max backoff ceiling.

ground_truth.description: Regression risk not covered: exponential delay alteration lacks test verifying maximum delay cap under large attempt counts.
ground_truth.explanation: Altering retry backoff mechanics from linear to exponential creates high risk of worker starvation if max ceiling regressions occur.

expected_evidence.description: Modified core algorithm lacks regression test covering attempt >= 20.
